items.title: Carolyn Buck Interview, 1969-03-25
items.q: He liked Denmark quite a bit. He always spoke to Denmark quite highly. And Papa Boo.

ctx.x: Did George, you say, what were the places he went, like Japan the best. Did he, can you say anything about that or traveling or where he likes to be out of the way and so on?

Well, Japan was his favorite. Why? I believe it was the countryside, the people themselves. He liked, he liked all traveling. He was one that, I believe, much of his illness that he had had was the fact that he couldn't travel. Toward the end, especially when his feet started getting in trouble. He liked Denmark quite a bit. He always spoke to Denmark quite highly. And Papa Boo. But everything was Japan. I don't know. He always said, he says, Carol, when I get better, he said, we're going to go back to Japan. He…
Did he have any special favorites among the musicians or did he say anything about that?
